result.markdown:
For a small customer support team, I'd recommend **Freshdesk as the best all-round help desk software**, particularly if you want something affordable, easy to manage and capable of growing with your business.

However, the best choice depends on whether you mainly handle email tickets, live chat, customer enquiries across multiple channels, or technical support.

Here are the platforms I'd shortlist.

## Best help desk software compared

![Top Free Customer Service Software in 2026 - Freshworks](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/5E2r2AcnIDT8zxLIiBADz7hJ8MoDzh_ulTvFG_8pkN5lnYNePkWR9wfYBeU0JTCyXfieSrXS13FyL6gvZXQBafGdl1pgWMvhtSXXYb4lkixcjz35s8nCMtgLbBtCtMUBB-S50yzPR2WJ7cFRTyIsXX65wwHU3s7ubgQYwXkEN4rZ-JrQ3s4HUtiKIs0TK67p?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Freshdesk**

(Best overall)

- Excellent ticket management and automation.
- Email, chat and multichannel support.
- Knowledge base and reporting.
- Good scope to grow as the team expands.
  
  Indicative starting price: \$19/agent/month, annual billing.
  
  [Freshdesk website](https://www.freshworks.com/freshdesk/)

---

![Help Scout - All-in-one customer support hub | AppSumo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/n_EPCHbDjGUQckzbuk0xSInWiQor8Jt5lpmA1an3yvR3HWIlso5lK3skEbp7Y1FRh5FIH-gBcTn6X8IHL0APiloqylLeSs1f9hB2HPsXecOpmCbf5hK_2eVLBcSLy6iOb6Hpo9_HhCy0tp8UV6B7gyjvnNlt6jXZb070QndROYm3USkYiVGZrRR3ZW1vtyVF?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Help Scout**

(Best for simplicity)

- Very easy for a small team to learn.
- Shared inbox and internal collaboration.
- Knowledge base and customer communication.
- Less complex than traditional enterprise help desks.
  
  Free for up to 5 users; paid from \$25/user/month annually.
  
  [Help Scout website](https://www.helpscout.com/)

---

![Top 5 MightyCall Alternatives in 2026 | Aircall](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/eK8d8Hg27KjN4DCc_gFSeRi1ePVLtbIteywPR0C0CtH0_ITtOxpaqRorJrjLDrHMk7fjSLlk7S85KaMsclFMA2xaQrI88tFlUJ0AlCq0aak7TyJI5CzOY5loc_5o5TC-4JTs7E43dwzqQoEzRyc6dqhkQGvfUAdvMKwMoxFF0czMWWrQOuqZvBH9tsznk-h1?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho Desk**

(Best budget option)

- Good ticketing and workflow automation.
- Useful reporting and customer history.
- Particularly good if you already use Zoho CRM.
  
  Free for up to 3 agents; paid plans from around \$7/user/month annually.
  
  [Zoho Desk website](https://www.zoho.com/desk/)

---

![Zendesk vs. Zoho Desk (2026): Premium Depth vs. Best Value](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/eYp_zbU-lYGSzk6vRWA1eFOnjLgiqHKbK0vDz7UXM99pYdpTQMQYq5VSHoKV6ygXD-_vADTXowBMZq1e8LfwqYbC7vmYRwJQsy8p8myOTae1wP1AtZ2CcORKES_3pMcLkv7fyoY3uWAadK1EXIkck05wwcA9ONhEFdBMivQryVH1iho2neAwfh2OUw3lmzCU?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zendesk**

- Powerful ticket routing and workflows.
- Excellent reporting and integrations.
- Suitable for more complex support operations.
- Can become expensive as you add features.
  
  Entry-level pricing around £15/agent/month, with more complete suites costing more.
  
  [Zendesk website](https://www.zendesk.co.uk/)

---

![5 Best Customer Experience Management Software in 2026! (Tested & Reviewed)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/d30JxstLN54EiT4kyhk0JV6uijnetGozEvMxYHaRMumIEvOlPyo-P1Pd5woSVIOC_kdDX9IgFHbBR_6KWIRtKGVdvQLE8JCFNKAutKbVsGBivBKKr-anulNnxQGrjSjMEjQ9YnXvJKYeyYkY6-vPJJx_vwdc_wR10agXKsDAzcF_q53i0Hb_bRjn-ZePIcuM?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Intercom**

- Excellent website messaging and live chat.
- Strong AI customer support capabilities.
- Particularly useful for SaaS and online businesses.
- Costs can increase with AI usage.
  
  Entry pricing around \$29/seat/month annually, plus potential AI charges.
  
  [Intercom website](https://www.intercom.com/)

Pricing is indicative, based on published 2026 plan information. USD prices are not direct UK quotes; check regional pricing, VAT, billing terms and add-ons. [www.itechguides.com](https://www.itechguides.com/best-help-desk-software-of-2026-the-right-choice-for-every-support-team/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.freshworks.com](https://www.freshworks.com/helpdesk/software/small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[getomnichannel.com](https://getomnichannel.com/helpdesk-ticketing/best-helpdesk-ticketing-software/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.zendesk.co.uk](https://www.zendesk.co.uk/service/help-desk-software/small-businesses/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down to\:

- **Freshdesk** if you want a proper ticketing system with automation and room to grow.
- **Help Scout** if you want a straightforward system that your team can start using quickly.
- **Zoho Desk** if keeping costs down is your biggest priority.

## What I'd look for in a small-team help desk

Regardless of which platform you choose, I'd prioritise these six features\:

1. Shared inbox with automatic ticket creation.
2. Ticket assignment so every enquiry has an owner.
3. Priority levels and escalation rules.
4. Internal notes and team collaboration.
5. Reporting on response times and resolution times.
6. Automation for repetitive enquiries and customer updates.

## Let me narrow it down to the best fit

There are a few things that would change my recommendation.
